title: Tape bound for the module bank
statement: Let $S,J,E,I$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, with work-tape counts $k_S,k_J,k_E,k_I$. For each of the five modules formed from the release-wrapped input copier and these four machines, the number of work tapes is at most $1+k_S+k_J+k_E+k_I$.
hypotheses_covered: Four supplied finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
The module index ranges over the five modules
replaced: For all four supplied machines, every one of the five body modules has at most $1$ plus the sum of the four machines' tape counts many tapes, so one finite shared bank with a real data tape contains every module.
